ultrarare_1_4.evidence_status: prospective heldout species-layer support within one geographic system

closed_replication_lanes.boreal_birds: pilot terminated at routing-header schema mismatch; no rerun
closed_replication_lanes.GIFT_plants: fresh attempt terminal without ecological primary
closed_replication_lanes.sw_finland_plants: source identity not response-independently estimable before future outcome

ecological_synthesis.core_positive: in the sparsest prospectively tested mammal occupancy regime, exact occupied-source topology contains heldout presence information beyond source count, direct source proximity and generic island geography
ecological_synthesis.occupancy_regime_boundary: the topology-specific effect is not supported in the adjacent 5-12 layer and is absent in the higher-occupancy exploratory layer
ecological_synthesis.response_free_mechanism: finite-source theory predicts that source-position heterogeneity becomes proportionally more exposed as occupied-source number falls
ecological_synthesis.temporal_boundary: static source-network importance has not been validated as temporal demographic dependence; the completed BALA source-loss test was not supportive
ecological_synthesis.independent_colonization_replication: not obtained because the SW Finland public archive failed the pre-outcome exact-source estimability gate

analysis_state.primary_next_step: manuscript synthesis and submission package using frozen evidence; do not delay for another opportunistic candidate
analysis_state.reopening_condition: only a genuinely independent non-eBird temporal island dataset with source state prospectively estimable from response-independent records
